title: Towards Cross-Lingual Explanation of Artwork in Large-scale Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance on artwork explanation generation tasks across 10 different languages using Entity Coverage, Entity F1, and Entity Cooccurrence metrics, specifically testing different combinations of instruction and output languages to measure the performance gap between English and non-English settings.

Creating a multilingual evaluation dataset sourced directly from native Wikipedia articles across 10 languages rather than using machine-translated English text, thereby avoiding translation-induced cultural biases and testing the models' ability to handle country-specific phrases and nuances.
